# noust_environment (Resource)

An environment of a project, such as `staging`. Every project is made with a `production` environment, so manage that one by importing it. Deleting an environment is refused by the server while it still holds anything.

Needs the permission `teams.manage` and sudo mode to delete.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every project is made with a production environment; add the others.
resource "noust_environment" "staging" {
  team    = noust_team.acme.slug
  project = noust_project.web.slug
  name    = "Staging"
  slug    = "staging"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The environment's display name.
- `project` (String) The slug of the project. Changing it replaces the environment.
- `team` (String) The slug of the team. Changing it replaces the environment.

### Optional

- `slug` (String) The environment's slug. Made from the name when omitted. Changing it replaces the environment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The team's, the project's and the environment's slugs, joined with slashes: `team/project/environment`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The team's, the project's and the environment's slugs, joined with slashes.
terraform import noust_environment.staging acme/web/staging
```
